_comment: PROTOTYPE. The framework-owned tree (#42069 §2). Apps declare deps in their OWN package.json; this installs one tree for all of them. Not a yarn workspace root -- workspaces hoist and nest on conflict rather than fail, and the charter wants hard failure.
name: @frappe/frontend

dependencies._singletons: vue, vue-router, frappe-ui, @framework/ui, reka-ui, dompurify -- version pinned HERE; an app naming any of them at a different range fails at manifest assembly, before vite starts (#42069 §3)
